rubrics_metrics.name: Biographies of living persons — sourcing and removal of contentious material
rubrics_metrics.description: This section of a biography of a living person needs additional citations for verification. Contentious material about living persons that is unsourced or poorly sourced must be removed immediately from the article and its talk page, especially if potentially libelous.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Please help by adding reliable sources. Find sources: news, newspapers, books, scholar, JSTOR. Learn how and when to remove this message; unsourced or poorly sourced contentious material about living persons should be removed promptly to avoid potential libel.
